title: Create agency API endpoints and register router in FastAPI app
description:
Create chatbot/api/agency.py exposing a FastAPI APIRouter with endpoints for initiative settings management, notification polling, check-in triggering, and schedule viewing. Then modify chatbot/api/app.py to register the agency_router on the FastAPI application instance.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- docs/architecture.md
- chatbot/agency/__init__.py (created by task a.1)
- chatbot/agency/scheduler.py (created by task a.1 — understand Scheduler API)
- chatbot/agency/checkins.py (created by task a.2 — understand CheckInGenerator and CheckInType)
- chatbot/agency/notifications.py (created by task a.3 — understand NotificationQueue API)
- chatbot/agency/initiative.py (created by task a.4 — understand InitiativeLevel and get/set API)
- chatbot/api/__init__.py (existing API package init)
- chatbot/api/app.py (existing FastAPI app — understand the import pattern, FastAPI instance variable name, and include_router convention)

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY chatbot/api/agency.py and chatbot/api/app.py. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance.

Part 1 — chatbot/api/agency.py:

1. Create a FastAPI APIRouter named agency_router with prefix '/agency' and tag 'agency'.

2. Pydantic models: InitiativeResponse (user_id, level, quiet_hours_start|None, quiet_hours_end|None), InitiativeUpdateRequest (level string, quiet_hours_start|None, quiet_hours_end|None), NotificationResponse (notification_id, user_id, notif_type, title, body, created_at, read, dismissed, metadata), NotificationListResponse (notifications list[NotificationResponse], pending_count int), CheckInTriggerRequest (checkin_type string, user_id string, context dict|None), CheckInResponse (checkin_id, message, checkin_type, priority), ScheduleResponse (events list[dict], next_event dict|None).

3. Module-level singletons: Scheduler, CheckInGenerator, NotificationQueue, ProjectInitiative (from chatbot/agency modules).

4. Endpoints: GET /initiative/{user_id} returns InitiativeResponse. PUT /initiative/{user_id} accepts InitiativeUpdateRequest, validates level string against InitiativeLevel, returns 400 for invalid. GET /notifications/{user_id} with optional since query param, returns NotificationListResponse. PUT /notifications/{notification_id}/read returns 404 for unknown. PUT /notifications/{notification_id}/dismiss returns 404 for unknown. POST /checkins/trigger accepts CheckInTriggerRequest, delegates to CheckInGenerator. GET /schedule/{user_id} returns ScheduleResponse.

Part 2 — chatbot/api/app.py:

1. Import agency_router from chatbot.api.agency.
2. Add app.include_router(agency_router) following existing convention.
3. Do NOT create a new FastAPI instance, change existing router registrations, or add middleware.
acceptance_criteria: chatbot/api/agency.py exists with agency_router and all Pydantic models
agency_router has GET/PUT /initiative/{user_id}, GET /notifications/{user_id}, PUT /notifications/{notification_id}/read and /dismiss, POST /checkins/trigger, GET /schedule/{user_id}
PUT /initiative validates level string against InitiativeLevel enum, returns 400 for invalid
Notification read/dismiss endpoints return 404 for unknown notification_id
No auth, rate-limiting, or middleware in the agency router
chatbot/api/app.py imports agency_router and registers it via app.include_router()
Existing router registrations in app.py are unchanged
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify any file outside chatbot/api/agency.py and chatbot/api/app.py
modify any existing API endpoint files except app.py
add auth, rate-limiting, CORS, or middleware
call LLM providers from any endpoint
create a new FastAPI instance in app.py
change the Abracapocus runtime, orchestrator, or backends

allowed: use FastAPI APIRouter with prefix and tag
use module-level singleton instances for Scheduler and NotificationQueue
return standard HTTP status codes for errors (400, 404, 422)
add a single import and include_router call in app.py
forbidden: implement business logic in endpoint handlers (delegate to chatbot/agency modules)
add middleware, auth, rate-limiting, or CORS
return raw internal objects in responses
refactor existing router registrations in app.py
